cards.title: Parents: Don't Buy Grand Theft Auto VI for Kids
cards.body: Rockstar's 18-rated game is stuffed with explicit sex, drugs, and violence—the most graphic content in the series. It's genuinely not appropriate for children, no matter how much they beg.

cards.title: Help Children Cope With Loss, Begin With the End
cards.body: Parents can't shield kids from uncertainty or loss, but can build their capacity to emerge from challenging periods without lasting harm. Starting conversations early helps children develop resilience.

cards.title: How to Cure Grand Theft Auto Craze: Get Kids Knitting
cards.body: Simply asking children to turn off games won't work without offering something purposeful in return. Knitting and creative activities give kids a sense of achievement and belonging.

cards.title: Professionals May Overlook Intrafamilial Child Torture
cards.body: Children tortured by caregivers aren't always easy to identify in clinical settings. Understanding various warning signs helps professionals spot abuse and protect vulnerable kids.
